# Infrastructure for the AI Agent Era

[Your AI agents need two things: connectivity to your services, and skills to get work done. Chrono AI provides both.]{.lead}

::: {.cta-row}
[NyxID — Connectivity](nyxid.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
[Ornn — Skills](ornn.qmd){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
:::

::: {.features-grid}
::: {.feature-card}
### NyxID

The open-source Agent Connectivity Gateway. Connect any private service to any AI agent. Credential injection, NAT traversal, REST-to-MCP auto-wrap. Built in Rust.

[Learn more →](nyxid.qmd)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### Ornn

The AI Skill Platform. Search, install, and share skills across devices. Create posters, build presentations, collaborate through Lark/Slack. Your AI agent does anything.

[Learn more →](ornn.qmd)
:::

::: {.feature-card}
### How They Work Together

NyxID connects your agent to services. Ornn gives your agent skills. One command to set up. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and more.
:::
:::

::: {.stack-section}
```
Your Services → NyxID (connectivity) → Ornn (skills) → Your AI Agent Does Anything
```

**NyxID** — Open-source Agent Connectivity Gateway. Connect any service to any AI agent, with built-in credential security.

**Ornn** — AI Skill Platform. Search, install, and share skills. Sync across devices.

**Aevatar** — Distributed agent runtime. Host persistent AI agents in the cloud. (Coming soon)
:::
